text:
Sharon Wilkins 
Home Care RN
“Prestige Care”
393 Victoria Road
Newtown
Braybrook
05/12/2017
Dear Sharon Wilkins,
Re: Mrs. Aisha Amari, 75 years old
I am writing to refer Aisha, who has been suffering from chronic ankle pain, and requires some personal assistance at home. 
Aisha visited our clinic today for her ankle pain, which has been advised to take Paracetemol as needed and deep heat cream for topical use. Despite this, she can walk independently.
In terms of her medical history, Aisha has suffered from hypertension for three years, and type 2 diabetes for 18 months, for which she is on a particular diet and self-managed of her medications. She also has blurry vision as a result of retinal damage.
Although Aisha’s hearing and speech are good, she speaks only Arabic, for which you can get her son, Ahmed, who is her main carer and interpreter, to help with communication. Ahmed also reminds her to take medications as she suffers from mild memory loss.
Aisha requires your assistance for checking her foot and ankle, dressing, some domestic chores and laundry, as well as showering two days per week and four hours per day. Also, as there are no assistive devices in Aisha’s home, would you kindly ensure they are properly installed?
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Your sincerely,
RN
(200 words)
